data.scope: Original V16 Amin case1 public wires only. Optimistic single shortest owned-chain defense upper bound; no policy/engine inference, enemy identity inference or rescue claim.
assumptions: Existing class excludes general as route donor; home target garrison retained.
At most ten friendly full-transfer actions. Every donor counted once on a shortest owned route.
No mid-route enemy collision/depletion or home-uncovering checks; feasibility here is optimistic.
Enemy screens lie on currently-public shortest paths to home; enemy future merges ignored.
Required force range accounts only current visible own/neutral garrisons along shortest enemy paths.
Home growth before attack counted; no land tick occurs in520–531.
Other serial/non-shortest routes, multiple independent feed chains or early strategic prepositioning are not excluded.

data.bound_limit: Existing owned army gathering into home, no army from enemy captures or victory elsewhere. No land tick/castle growth occurs520–531. Repeated transfers cannot create original donor material; direct teleport ignored travel is deliberately optimistic.

limitations: Three consumed physical maps with exact label mirrors, not18 independent observations.
Archived V6 proposals only exist for these V16 records. Missing V10 alternatives are explicitly unmeasured; V10-v6 contains no V8 concentration stage.
Static residual excludes enemy joint actions/growth; reference capture is feasible from current public input, not a counterfactual outcome.
Later objective ownership is an observation, not attribution to the original direct plan after retargeting. Continuous ownership uses own-tile visibility; terminal horizons are censored.
Toward-home means Manhattan geometry only; backtracking means exact preceding source/destination reversal. Neither alone proves strategic harm.
Next actions represent observed stack continuity, not individual army identity after merges. No policy inference or matches.
